description: CITTA METROPOLITANA MILANO - Punti WI FI is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Lombardia. La Città metropolitana di Milano rende disponibili punti di accesso WI FI nelle proprie sedi nel Parco Idroscalo e in alcuni istituti scolastici per accedere a Internet gratuitamente per quattro ore al giorno (utenza e password saranno forniti via sms previa registrazione. Coverage: Regione Lombardia. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Lombardia. Its tags are accesso-internet, banda-larga, rete, wireless. It offers 4 resource(s) in GEOJSON, KML, KMZ, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
